visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish hair wearing pink fuzzy pajamas and a man with glasses in a white t-shirt sit cross-legged on a light gray floor in a home living room. They are talking animatedly towards the camera; behind them, a pile of clothes sits on a sofa. (2) The woman spreads a deck of playing cards face down on the floor. She points to specific cards with her right hand while looking at the camera with a wide smile. (3) The woman flips several cards one by one, revealing their values. The camera remains static as she points to each revealed card, her facial expressions showing increasing excitement and suspense through wide eyes and a large open-mouthed grin. (4) Both the man and woman fall backward onto the floor in a moment of extreme reaction, kicking their legs in the air. The man is on the right and the woman on the left. (5) The man takes his turn, picking and flipping cards from the spread while the woman watches closely, resting her chin on her hand. They continue to interact with large hand gestures and high facial energy. (6) A smartphone is held close to the camera lens, showing a bank transfer interface with text and numbers. (7) A small boy in a red Spider-Man shirt joins the couple on the floor. All three face the camera, waving and smiling with their hands folded in a traditional greeting posture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The master track opens with a cheerful, high-tempo synthesizer BGM. A female voice speaks with high pitch and fast speech rate, overlapping with a slightly lower male voice. Both display high vocal arousal and positive valence. (2) Faint rustling and sliding sound transients are heard, consistent with thin cardboard objects moving against a hard surface. The voices alternate between focused dialogue and loud laughter. (3) A sudden musical shift occurs to a dramatic orchestral fanfare with a strong marching beat. The male voice emits a loud, high-intensity shout followed by prolonged laughter. (4) Multiple layers of human vocalizations, including shouting and laughter, mix with the recurring BGM. A soft rhythmic thudding sound occurs periodically. (5) The mix concludes with three distinct voices, including a high-pitched child's voice, speaking in a synchronized, rhythmic greeting. The BGM remains constant until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a humorous festive activity where a couple uses a card game to determine the amount of money for a Chinese New Year red envelope. The video aims to entertain through relatable domestic interaction and high-energy reactions to the random outcomes of the game, ending with a family holiday greeting.
